theater: 北高加索山前地帶與達吉斯坦

battle.name: 高加索戰爭
battle.theater: 北高加索山前地帶與達吉斯坦
battle.brief: 一八一七年一月，葉爾莫洛夫接掌外高加索軍團，戰事在高加索山脈北麓與達吉斯坦村落間展開。俄軍以燧發火槍配刺刀的方陣步步為營，沿捷列克河築堡壘線；山民以長矛、彎刀、長身火槍襲擊落單騎兵。卡面長槍代表已被方陣取代的長矛兵制，護住火槍手裝填由刺刀承接，長矛餘緒留在哥薩克騎手的騎槍上。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 交戰一方是俄羅斯帝國的邊疆軍團體系。一八一三年古利斯坦條約之後，俄國取得達吉斯坦與東喬治亞，一八○一年吞併卡爾特利-卡赫蒂王國，一八○四年至一八一三年的俄土戰爭又令帝國把手伸到外高加索；一八一六年四月廿一日，亞歷山大一世任命葉爾莫洛夫為駐喬治亞俄軍總司令兼獨立格魯吉亞軍團司令，該軍團後來改稱高加索軍團。軍團下轄常備步兵團、庫班與捷列克兩支高加索線哥薩克騎兵團、騎砲兵與六磅、十二磅野戰砲隊，並以格魯吉亞人、明格利亞人及地方民兵組成的地方部隊填補人力。俄軍沿亞速-莫茲多克線與高加索線配置堡壘，用維拉第卡夫卡茲、格羅茲尼、聶爾奇克等節點串成一道向山前伸展的堡壘鏈。另一方是北高加索諸部族的聯盟：阿迪格（切爾克斯）、阿布茲、阿布哈茲、烏比赫、切欽、阿瓦爾、達爾金、列茲金以及奧格爾、卡爾巴爾的山前部落，各以村社為單位組織步騎游擊隊，配備長矛、彎刀與購自鄂圖曼、波斯商路或擄自俄軍的長身火槍。三○年代起加齊·穆哈默德、哈姆扎特·貝克、哈吉·穆拉德等人借那喀什班底教團的號召聚合部眾，一八三四年伊瑪目沙米爾建國，把分散的游擊隊編為軍隊，令部族抵抗第一次有了國家形式。俄國並非單獨作戰：一八二六至一八二八年的俄波戰爭把兵力拉向亞塞拜然，一八五三至一八五五年的克里米亞戰爭期間俄軍一度與沙米爾達成停戰，英國與法國則在君士坦丁堡與倫敦關注通往印度的通道與鄂圖曼邊境。
countriesEn: One side was the frontier corps system of the Russian Empire. After the Treaty of Gulistan of 1813 Russia held Dagestan and eastern Georgia; in 1801 it annexed the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti, and the Russo-Turkish War of 1804-1813 pushed the empire further into the Transcaucasus. On 21 April 1816 Alexander I appointed Aleksey Yermolov commander-in-chief of the Russian forces in Georgia and commander of the Independent Georgian Corps, later renamed the Caucasus Corps. The corps contained regular infantry regiments, the Kuban and Terek line Cossack horse regiments, horse artillery and field guns of six and twelve pounds, and local formations raised from Georgians, Mingrelians and regional militia to make up the numbers. The Russians distributed fortifications along the Azov-Mozdok line and the Caucasian line, stringing forts together into a chain pushing into the plains: Vladikavkaz, Grozny, Nalchik and others. The other side was a coalition of the North Caucasian peoples: the Adyghe (Circassians), Abazins, Abkhazians, Ubykhs, Chechens, Avars, Dargins, Lezghins, plus the plains tribes of the Ossetes and Karbals. They raised war bands of foot and horse around each village community, armed with spears, sabres and long guns bought on the Ottoman and Persian trade routes or taken from Russian soldiers. From the 1830s Gazi-Mohammed, Hamzat Bek and Hadji Murad drew the mountaineers together under the banner of the Naqshbandi order, and in 1834 Imam Shamil founded a state that turned scattered bands into an army, giving tribal resistance a national form for the first time. Russia was not fighting alone: the Russo-Persian War of 1826-1828 pulled troops towards Azerbaijan, during the Crimean War of 1853-1855 the Russian army even reached a truce with Shamil, and in Constantinople and London Britain and France watched the road to India and the Ottoman frontier.
people: 亞歷山大一世在位期間先把格魯吉亞與達吉斯坦收入版圖，葉爾莫洛夫則是這場戰爭前半段最關鍵的俄方人物。這位一七七七年生於奧廖爾的將軍，參加過一八一二年博羅季諾戰役與一八一三年庫爾姆戰役，一八一六年被派往高加索，一八一七年加固孫查河渡口，一八一八年建成格羅茲尼堡，之後在捷列克河與孫查河匯流處設下被稱作阿爾法營的堡壘營盤，並推動修築新市鎮、整治第比利斯與格魯吉亞軍用大道。他的做法是以縱隊主動深入山區、燒毀拒絕歸順的村落、把山前平原闢作哥薩克定居地，試圖用速度與縱深換取部族的屈服；一八二二年布依納克斯克攻城失利後，聖彼得堡派出的調查團指責他擴張過度，其攻勢受挫，一八二七年十二月七日他被解職，由帕斯凱維奇接掌。史家摩謝·加默指其嚴酷手段非但沒有征服山民，反而加深怨恨並讓伊斯蘭勢力擴散。山民方面的關鍵人物是加齊·穆哈默德、哈姆扎特·貝克與哈吉·穆拉德，一八三四年後由伊瑪目沙米爾接手，他於一八四三年發動三路攻勢重創阿瓦爾俄軍，一八四五年頂住沃龍佐夫的大軍，一八五九年被米留京所部在古尼布擒獲。俄方後續的指揮官還有沃龍佐夫（一八四四至一八五三年）與巴亞京斯基（一八五三至一八五六年），後者指揮二十五萬大軍完成對達吉斯坦的總攻。文人也在此處留下痕跡：普希金一八二○至一八二一年在高加索寫下《高加索囚人》，萊爾蒙托夫一八三九年經瓦列里克河之戰寫成同名詩篇，托爾斯泰則把高加索的經歷帶進《戰爭與和平》。
peopleEn: Alexander I set the imperial expansion going by absorbing Georgia and Dagestan, and Yermolov became the decisive Russian figure of the first half of the war. Born in Oryol in 1777, the general had fought at Borodino in 1812 and at Kulm in 1813 before being sent to the Caucasus in 1816. In 1817 he fortified the crossing of the Sunzha, in 1818 he built the fortress of Grozny, and he later established the fortified camp at the junction of the Terek and the Sunzha, known as the Alfa camp, while pushing new towns, the rebuilding of Tiflis and the Georgian Military Road. His method was to strike deep into the mountains with columns, burn the villages of those who refused submission, open the plains for Cossack settlement and trade speed and depth for the submission of the tribes. After the failed assault on Buynaksk in 1822 an investigating mission from St Petersburg blamed him for overreach, his offensive stalled, and on 7 December 1827 he was relieved and replaced by Paskevich. The historian Moshe Gammer argued that his brutality failed to subdue the mountaineers, hardened their hatred and strengthened the spread of Islam. On the mountaineer side the key figures were Gazi-Mohammed, Hamzat Bek and Hadji Murad; from 1834 the imam Shamil took over, launching a three-pronged offensive that mauled the Russian positions in Avaria in 1843, holding off Vorontsov's army in 1845 and being captured at Gunib by Milyutin's men in 1859. The later Russian commanders were Vorontsov (1844-1853) and Baryatinsky (1853-1856), the latter directing the final offensive with 250,000 men. Writers left their marks here too: Pushkin wrote The Prisoner of the Caucasus during his stay of 1820-1821, Lermontov turned the battle on the Valerik river of 1839 into a poem of the same name, and Tolstoy carried his Caucasian service into War and Peace.
kits: 卡面這件長槍是十六世紀以來方陣的核心：長矛排在前排，為身後的火槍手擋住騎兵衝鋒，也讓對手無法靠近正在裝填的射手；西班牙大方陣的長矛與火槍編隊，確定了近代步兵的基本樣貌。到了一八一七年，歐洲戰線的長槍早已退入軍械庫，這場高加索戰爭的俄軍同樣不帶長槍出戰，方陣的任務由一七九七年式刺刀承接，刺刀與滑膛燧發火槍組成營方陣，用密閉的槍刺牆面對付騎兵。真正還保留長槍形制的，是高加索線哥薩克騎手的騎槍：哥薩克以馬槍、彎刀與卡賓槍配備，衝鋒時排成縱隊舉槍，與卡面長槍同源，只是用上了馬力與速度。山民方面沒有火槍工廠，用的是經商路買入或從俄軍擄獲的長身火槍，另有大量長矛、標槍與可投擲的短矛，配彎刀與匕首，著皮甲與鐵胸甲，戴毛皮帽、披斗篷，靠馬匹與步眾在峽谷中作戰。俄軍的火力核心是六磅與十二磅野戰砲，攻城則靠突擊砲與工兵架設的射擊陣位，一八二二年布依納克斯克一役即以砲兵配合工兵強攻土牆。補給端依賴亞洲式牛車與牛隊，從維拉第卡夫卡茲沿格魯吉亞軍用大道運糧，全程約二百俄里，冬季積雪與牛車運力不足，限制了每一次遠征的深度。
kitsEn: The pike on the card face was the core of the sixteenth-century formation: the pikes stood in front to shield the musketeers behind them from cavalry charges and to keep enemies away from shooters in the middle of a reload; the pike-and-shot organisation of the Spanish tercio fixed the basic shape of modern infantry. By 1817 the pike had long since been retired into the arsenals of the European battle line, and the Russian army in this Caucasian war did not carry pikes into the field either. The task of the pike was taken over by the 1797 pattern bayonet, and bayonets fixed to smoothbore flintlock muskets formed the battalion square, presenting a closed wall of steel against horsemen. The one place where the pike shape genuinely survived was the lance of the Caucasian line Cossacks: a Cossack was equipped with lance, sabre and carbine, and charged in line with the lance raised, the same weapon as the card but with the power of horse and speed behind it. The mountaineers had no arsenal of their own and used long guns bought along the trade routes or taken from Russian troops, together with large numbers of spears, javelins and throwing lances, sabres and daggers, leather and iron breastplates, fur caps and cloaks, fighting on foot and on horseback in the ravines. The core of Russian firepower was the six- and twelve-pounder field guns; for assaults they relied on howitzers and positions laid out by sappers, as at Buynaksk in 1822, where artillery and engineers went in against earthen walls. On the supply side everything moved on the Asiatic ox cart and ox train, carrying grain from Vladikavkaz along the Georgian Military Road, some two hundred versts in all, and winter snow with the limited haulage of the carts capped the depth of every expedition.
tactics: 俄軍的戰術可以概括為堡壘線逐堡推進：以縱隊沿谷地行軍，兩翼梯隊始終保持拒止的斜面，行軍縱隊之間互相策應，抵達堡壘後才展開成營方陣，砲兵集中火力封住隘口，輕步兵與哥薩克負責搜索與偵察，一旦受襲即退回最近的堡壘固守。一八二二年布依納克斯克攻城的失敗最能說明問題：俄軍以縱隊與散兵線進攻築有土牆與塹壕的山民堡壘，砲火無法壓住四面射擊的游擊隊，屢攻不下，傷亡慘重，最後退兵。山民的戰術是游擊與拖延：熟悉峽谷地形，選擇居高臨下的狹窄地段設伏，晝夜襲擾行軍縱隊與落單騎兵，擊退之後即散入山林，臨走前焚燒房屋與草料，使俄軍難以就地補給；騎兵以假退誘敵深入，再用游擊隊從側面壓上，迫其分兵。哥薩克則擔任巡邏、追擊與擾亂後方，保護運糧隊與驛遞線。沙米爾時代把這種打法推到頂點：一八四三年八月他以一萬人從三個方向合擊，攻破阿瓦爾除一個以外的俄軍據點；一八五九年巴亞京斯基以二十五萬大軍多路並進，用砲兵封鎖谷地、以縱隊直撲古尼布山頂，才迫使沙米爾出降。
tacticsEn: Russian tactics can be summed up as an advance from fort to fort along the fortified line. Columns marched up the valleys, the refusing flanks of the flanking echelons always kept an oblique face outward, marching columns covered one another, and the troops only deployed into battalion square on reaching a fort, the artillery massing its fire to seal the passes while light infantry and Cossacks searched and scouted; if attacked they fell back on the nearest fort and held it. The failure at Buynaksk in 1822 shows the problem most clearly: the Russians went in with columns and skirmish lines against a village fort ringed with earthen walls and ditches, the guns could not silence musketeers firing from every side, the assaults failed again and again at heavy cost, and the column finally withdrew. The mountaineers fought by harassment and delay. They knew the ravines, chose narrow high ground to lie in wait, attacked marching columns and isolated horsemen by day and by night, and after a blow scattered back into the hills, burning houses and fodder on the way out so that the Russians could not resupply where they stood. Their horsemen would feign a retreat to draw the enemy deep and then bring the bands in on the flank to force a division of the Russian line. Cossacks took on patrolling, pursuit and harrying of the rear, guarding supply convoys and the post road. Under Shamil this method reached its height: in August 1843 he converged with ten thousand men from three directions and took every Russian outpost in Avaria but one; in 1859 Baryatinsky, with 250,000 men advancing on several axes, sealed the valleys with artillery and drove columns straight at the summit of Gunib, and only then did Shamil capitulate.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點上。一八五九年收尾的總攻，俄軍常被記作約二十五萬人。二○年代中葉之後部族人口急劇下降：有統計稱卡爾巴爾的人口由戰前的三十五萬降至一八一八年的五萬，另一說則以一七九○年的二十萬與一八三○年的三萬作對照；留居比例上，切爾克斯人由一七九五年的四成降到一八三五年三成、一八五八年兩成半，切欽人為九厘、一成、八厘半，阿瓦爾人由一成一下滑到七厘再降到兩厘，達爾金人為九厘半、七厘三、五厘八，列茲金人為四厘四、三厘六、三厘九。戰敗後被迫遷往鄂圖曼的切爾克斯人以數十萬計，僅在薩姆松一地就曾收容約十一萬流民，某些時期每日死亡超過二百人。一八四三年八月廿八日，沙米爾一萬人三面合擊烏恩楚庫爾的俄軍縱隊，殺傷四百八十六人；接下來四週，攻陷阿瓦爾除一個以外的俄軍據點，俄軍守軍傷亡逾兩千人。堡壘線各節點相距數十俄里，格羅茲尼堡建於一八一八年，維拉第卡夫卡茲則早在一八○四年即已設立。戰事自一八一七年起，至一八六四年五月廿一日俄曆、六月二日新曆，亞歷山大二世詔令終止戰事，前後四十餘年。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around a few points. The Russian army at the final offensive of 1859 is commonly put at about 250,000 men. From the mid-1820s the population of the tribes fell away sharply: one reckoning has the people of Karbalia dropping from 350,000 before the war to 50,000 by 1818, while another compares 200,000 in 1790 with 30,000 in 1830. As for the share of the population remaining in the mountains, the Circassians went from forty per cent in 1795 to thirty per cent in 1835 and twenty-five per cent in 1858, the Chechens from nine to ten and eight and a half per cent, the Avars from eleven to seven and two per cent, the Dargins from nine and a half to seven and a half and five and a half per cent, and the Lezghins from four and a half to three and a half and four per cent. Those Circassians driven out after the war and moved towards the Ottoman Empire were counted in the hundreds of thousands, and Samsun alone at one point held about 110,000 refugees, with more than two hundred deaths a day during some phases of the transit. On 28 August 1843 Shamil converged with ten thousand men on a Russian column at Untsukul from three sides and killed 486 of the enemy; over the four weeks that followed, every Russian outpost in Avaria but one was taken, inflicting more than 2,000 casualties on the defenders. The nodes of the fortified line stood tens of versts apart, the fortress of Grozny going up in 1818 while Vladikavkaz had existed since 1804. The war ran from 1817 to the manifesto of Alexander II ending hostilities on 21 May in the Russian calendar, 2 June in the western one, in the year 1864, over forty years in all.
cause: 高加索戰爭的起因，是俄羅斯帝國在拿破崙戰爭前後推進的帝國擴張。拿破崙的失敗沒有令帝國止步，反而讓亞歷山大一世把目光投向高加索：一八○一年吞併卡爾特利-卡赫蒂，一八一三年以古利斯坦條約取得達吉斯坦與東喬治亞，一八一六年再把獨立的格魯吉亞軍團交給葉爾莫洛夫。俄國的考量既有戰略的，也有經濟的：控制高加索山脈等於把通往波斯、印度與中亞的門戶握在手中，同時把哥薩克邊民推到前線當作屏障，並切斷鄂圖曼與波斯在高加索的聯繫。政策在一八一七年之後變得急躁，葉爾莫洛夫不再滿足於守住防線，而是主張主動進攻、以殘酷手段拆毀村落、用平原化與哥薩克定居切斷游擊隊的根基。對山民一方，開戰的理由同樣具體：拒絕被帝國兼併、拒絕交稅服役、拒絕改宗，村社自治與宗族結構不容外人介入；當俄軍燒村與築堡之後，抵抗又添上一層宗教色彩，那喀什班底教團在山區的傳播，把零散的部落武裝連成聯盟。國際層面同樣推波助瀾：英國自一八○一年蘭斯多夫條約起便在高加索問題上與俄國交涉，一八二六年的英俄協議把高加索排除在英國勢力範圍之外，而一八二六至一八二八年的俄波戰爭與一八五三至一八五五年的克里米亞戰爭，屢次把俄國的注意力與兵力拉向別處，令高加索的戰線時緊時鬆。
causeEn: The Caucasian War began as an imperial expansion pushed forward by Russia around the time of the Napoleonic Wars. The defeat of Napoleon did not stop the empire; it turned Alexander I's attention towards the Caucasus. In 1801 he annexed Kartli-Kakheti, in 1813 the Treaty of Gulistan brought Dagestan and eastern Georgia into his hands, and in 1816 the Independent Georgian Corps was handed over to Yermolov. Russian calculations were both strategic and economic: control of the Caucasus range meant holding the gateway towards Persia, India and Central Asia, it meant pushing the Cossack border population forward as a screen, and it meant cutting the Ottoman and Persian connections inside the mountains. After 1817 the policy grew impatient. Yermolov was no longer content to hold the defensive line; he argued for active attack, for tearing down the villages by harsh means, for using the plains and Cossack settlement to cut the guerrillas off from their base. For the mountaineers the reasons were just as concrete: refusal to be annexed, to pay tax and serve, or to change faith, and a village society and clan structure that admitted no outside interference. Once the Russians began burning villages and planting forts, resistance took on a religious colouring as well, and the spread of the Naqshbandi order through the mountains linked scattered tribal bands into a coalition. The international setting pushed in the same direction: from the Treaty of London of 1801 onwards Britain and Russia argued over the Caucasus question, and the 1826 Anglo-Russian agreement placed the region outside British spheres of interest, while the Russo-Persian War of 1826-1828 and the Crimean War of 1853-1855 repeatedly dragged Russian attention and troops elsewhere, so that the Caucasian front tightened and slackened in turn.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是北高加索被完整地劃入俄羅斯帝國版圖，伴隨而來的是高加索軍區的設立、哥薩克與俄羅斯殖民村鎮在山前平原的重新編排，以及格魯吉亞軍用大道沿線驛站與聚落的改造。人口代價極為沉重：留居比例的崩落、整村焚燒，以及大批居民被迫越境遷往鄂圖曼的所謂穆哈吉爾遷徙，徹底改變了北高加索的族群與宗教結構，也讓切爾克斯問題延續到二十世紀，成為俄羅斯與高加索關係最沉的一筆。政治上，沙米爾的伊瑪目國被歐洲視為反抗沙俄的象徵，英國在克里米亞戰爭前後曾以此作為干預的輿論依據；俄羅斯官方則把葉爾莫洛夫式的征服寫成秩序與教化的功業，兩種敘事在往後的文學與政治中長期角力。文化層面的後果最為持久：普希金的《高加索囚人》、萊爾蒙托夫的《瓦列里克河》與以高加索為背景的小說、托爾斯泰把軍旅見聞寫進《戰爭與和平》，高加索在俄羅斯文學中成為既誘人又危險的異域想像。軍事上，這段山地戰爭推動了俄軍輕步兵、遊騎兵與內陸砲兵的發展，也把哥薩克的邊疆角色制度化；同時它也留下教訓，即以火槍方陣對付善於游擊的部族，代價高昂而收益緩慢。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the war was the incorporation of the whole of the North Caucasus into the Russian Empire, together with the creation of a Caucasian military district, the reordering of Cossack and Russian settler villages across the plains, and the rebuilding of staging posts and settlements along the Georgian Military Road. The demographic cost was brutal: the collapse of the share of the population that remained, the burning of whole villages, and the forced migration across the frontier into Ottoman territory known as muhajirism changed the ethnic and religious shape of the North Caucasus beyond repair, and the Circassian question carried on into the twentieth century as the heaviest entry in the ledger of Russian-Caucasian relations. Politically, Shamil's imamate was read in Europe as the emblem of resistance to the Tsardom, and Britain drew on it as an argument for interference in the years around the Crimean War, while official Russian accounts wrote the conquest of the Yermolov type as the work of order and civilisation; the two narratives kept arguing in later literature and politics. The most lasting consequences were cultural: Pushkin's The Prisoner of the Caucasus, Lermontov's The Valerik River and his Caucasian fiction, Tolstoy's use of his campaigning memories in War and Peace, all of which turned the Caucasus into a Russia literature's land of both allure and danger. Militarily, the mountain war drove the development of Russian light infantry, irregular mounted units and mountain artillery, and institutionalised the frontier role of the Cossacks. It also left a lesson: a musket square turned against tribes expert in guerrilla war is expensive and slow to pay off.
result: 若只看一八一七年開局，這場戰爭是失敗的：葉爾莫洛夫的攻勢在布依納克斯克受挫，俄軍在山民游擊面前傷亡不斷，一八二五年沙皇亞歷山大一世去世、十二月事變爆發之後，帝國注意力轉向國內，戰線一度冷清。一八二七年帕斯凱維奇接任，改以懷柔與步步為營並重，用一八二八年的土庫曼恰伊條約從波斯手中取得更多土地，卻把更艱難的高加索留給後人。一八三四年沙米爾建國後抵抗達到高峰，一八四三與一八四五年的攻擊證明俄軍並非無懈可擊，直到克里米亞戰爭結束、帝國把二十五萬大軍投向高加索，戰局才在東線被扭轉：一八五九年古尼布一戰擒獲沙米爾，達吉斯坦方向的抵抗隨之瓦解。西部的高加索線另成一場俄羅斯-切爾克斯戰爭，打到一八六四年，帝國以殘酷手段與大規模強制遷移收尾，山民武裝的抵抗形式從會戰退回到游擊，而抵抗本身又延續下去。最終結果是雙重的：北高加索在版圖上歸入帝國，格羅茲尼與維拉第卡夫卡茲成為控制山地的支點，哥薩克定居體系就此定型；代價則是驚人的人口流失、一整代人的流亡，以及一段直到今天仍被不同敘事反覆書寫的戰爭記憶。
resultEn: Judged from its opening in 1817, the war was a failure. Yermolov's offensive was checked at Buynaksk, the Russians bled continuously against the mountaineers' harassment, and after the death of Alexander I in 1825 and the outbreak of the December rising the empire's attention turned inward and the front went quiet. Paskevich took over in 1827 and changed policy to a mixture of conciliation and patient advance, taking further territory from Persia in the Treaty of Turkmenchay of 1828 while leaving the harder Caucasus to his successors. After Shamil founded his state in 1834 the resistance reached its height, and the offensives of 1843 and 1845 showed that the Russian army was not invulnerable; only when the Crimean War ended and the empire threw 250,000 men into the mountains was the situation reversed in the east. The capture of Shamil at Gunib in 1859 broke the resistance in the Dagestan direction. In the west the Caucasian line became the separate Russo-Circassian War, which ran to 1864 and was closed by the imperial authorities with brutal measures and large-scale forced removal, the resistance of the armed mountain groups falling back from pitched battle to guerrilla warfare, and the resistance itself continuing. The outcome is double: the North Caucasus passed into the empire on the map, Grozny and Vladikavkaz became the hinges on which the mountains were held, and the Cossack settlement system was fixed for good; against that stand a staggering loss of population, a whole generation in exile, and a memory of the war that different narratives are still rewriting today.
